name: World Paint Material-State Inspector
purpose: Expose selected-cell material-family, layer, subcell, weight, sequence, and readiness data in the Paint tab without mixing UI, persistence, and deterministic world logic.

selected_cell_inspection.coordinates: selected tile x/y in canonical 32x32 world grid
selected_cell_inspection.entries: all material-state cell/layer records at that coordinate

module_boundaries.haven_world: inspection query structs/functions over material-state document
module_boundaries.haven_editor: future reusable egui inspector commands and property binding

multiplayer_policy: Inspector reads local material-state mirror/cache; authoritative edits still come from host/server paint deltas and material-state replication.
